```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| message: false

billboard <- read_csv("data/billboard.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r}
top_10_songs <- billboard |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"),
    names_to = "week",
    values_to = "rank",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) |>
  mutate(week = parse_number(week)) |>
  filter(min(rank) <= 10, .by = c(artist, track, date.entered))

notable_songs <- top_10_songs |>
  filter(track %in% c("Music", "Amazed", "Higher")) |>
  mutate(song = paste0(track, " (", artist, ")"))

ggplot(top_10_songs, aes(x = week, y = rank, group = track)) +
  geom_line(color = "gray75", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_line(
    data = notable_songs,
    aes(color = song),
    linewidth = 1.1
  ) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  labs(
    title = "Billboard Hot 100 Trajectories of Top-10 Songs",
    subtitle = "Highlighting the fastest to #1, slowest to #1, and longest chart run",
    x = "Week on Chart",
    y = "Rank",
    color = "Notable Songs"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
